sci6_u01.text: Plants that we grow only for one season and use as food are called?
sci6_u01.explanation: Plants of the same kind grown together on a large scale for food are called crops.

sci6_u01.text: Honey is mainly produced by which of these?
sci6_u01.explanation: Honey bees collect nectar from flowers and convert it into honey inside their hive.

sci6_u01.text: Animals that eat only plants are called?
sci6_u01.explanation: Cow, goat, deer and rabbit eat only plants — they are called herbivores.

sci6_u01.text: Which part of the wheat plant do we eat?
sci6_u01.explanation: Wheat grains are seeds. They are ground into flour to make rotis and bread.

sci6_u01.text: From which plant do we get sugar?
sci6_u01.explanation: Sugar is made from the juice of the sugarcane plant.

sci6_u01.text: Which of these animals provides milk?
sci6_u01.explanation: Cow, buffalo and goat are common milk-giving animals in India.

sci6_u01.text: Pulses such as moong and chana are obtained from which group of plants?
sci6_u01.explanation: Pulses come from leguminous plants — they store protein in their seeds.

sci6_u01.text: The edible part of a carrot is its?
sci6_u01.explanation: We eat the underground root of the carrot plant — it stores food for the plant.

sci6_u01.text: Tigers and lions are examples of?
sci6_u01.explanation: Animals that eat other animals are called carnivores.

sci6_u01.text: Humans, who eat both plants and animals, are called?
sci6_u01.explanation: Animals that eat both plants and animal products are called omnivores.

sci6_u02.text: Which nutrient mainly provides energy to our body?
sci6_u02.explanation: Carbohydrates are the body's main source of energy. Rice, wheat and potatoes are rich in them.
Proteins help in the growth and repair of our body, so they are called body-building foods.

sci6_u02.text: Scurvy is caused by the deficiency of which vitamin?
sci6_u02.explanation: Lack of Vitamin C causes scurvy — bleeding gums and slow healing of wounds. Citrus fruits prevent it.

sci6_u02.text: Goitre is caused by deficiency of which mineral?
sci6_u02.explanation: Iodine deficiency leads to goitre — a swelling in the neck. Iodised salt helps prevent it.

sci6_u02.text: Which of these is the richest source of fats?
sci6_u02.explanation: Butter, ghee, and oils are rich in fats — they give a lot of energy in a small quantity.

sci6_u02.text: Roughage in our food is provided mainly by?
sci6_u02.explanation: Roughage is plant fibre — it does not give energy but helps the body get rid of waste.

sci6_u02.text: Rickets is caused by lack of which vitamin?
sci6_u02.explanation: Vitamin D helps absorb calcium for strong bones. Without it, children can develop rickets.

sci6_u02.text: Anaemia is caused by deficiency of which mineral?
sci6_u02.explanation: Iron is needed to make haemoglobin in blood. Lack of iron causes weakness called anaemia.

sci6_u02.text: Which of these is a balanced diet?
options: Rice, dal, vegetables, fruits and milk
sci6_u02.explanation: A balanced diet has all nutrients in the right amounts — carbs, proteins, fats, vitamins and minerals.

sci6_u02.text: Which simple test is used to detect starch in food?
sci6_u02.explanation: A drop of iodine on a starchy food turns blue-black — that's how we test for starch.

sci6_c001.text: Which of these is the edible part of a carrot plant?
sci6_c001.explanation: We eat the underground root of a carrot — it stores food for the plant.

sci6_c001.text: From which plant do we get the spice 'ginger'?
sci6_c001.explanation: Ginger is an underground stem we use as a spice.

sci6_c001.text: Wheat that we eat is which part of the plant?
sci6_c001.explanation: Wheat grains are seeds that are ground to make flour.

sci6_c001.text: Cauliflower belongs to which plant part?
sci6_c001.explanation: Cauliflower is a flower head we eat as a vegetable.

sci6_c001.text: Which of these plant parts gives us spinach?
sci6_c001.explanation: Spinach is a leafy vegetable — we eat its leaves.

sci6_c002.text: Which of these animals gives us honey?
sci6_c002.explanation: Honey bees collect nectar from flowers and turn it into honey.

sci6_c002.text: Eggs are usually obtained from which animal?
sci6_c002.explanation: Hens lay eggs that are a common protein source.

sci6_c002.text: Which of these is an animal product?
sci6_c002.explanation: Butter is made from milk, which comes from animals like cows.
Curd is set by adding a starter to warm milk.

sci6_c002.text: Which of these animals is reared mainly for milk?
sci6_c002.explanation: Buffalo is one of the most common milk-giving animals in India.

sci6_c003.text: Animals that eat only plants are called?
sci6_c003.explanation: Cow, deer and rabbit eat only plants — they are herbivores.

sci6_c003.text: Which of these is a carnivore?
sci6_c003.explanation: Lions hunt and eat other animals — they are carnivores.

sci6_c003.text: Humans eat both plants and animal products. We are?
sci6_c003.explanation: Animals that eat both plants and animals are called omnivores.

sci6_c003.text: Which of these is an omnivore?
sci6_c003.explanation: Bears eat fruits, honey AND fish — they're omnivores.

sci6_c003.text: An eagle eats other animals. It is a?
sci6_c003.explanation: Eagles hunt smaller animals — they are carnivores.

sci6_c004.text: Potato is which part of the plant?
sci6_c004.explanation: Potato is an underground stem (a tuber).

sci6_c004.text: Which of these is a seed we eat?
sci6_c004.explanation: Mustard seeds are used as spice and to extract oil.
We crush the sugarcane stem to get sweet juice.

sci6_c004.text: Which of these is a fruit we eat?
sci6_c004.explanation: Mango is a sweet, juicy fruit of the mango tree.
A cabbage is a tight ball of leaves we eat as a vegetable.

sci6_c005.text: How many main nutrients do we usually count in food?
sci6_c005.explanation: The five main nutrients: carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, and minerals.
Roughage is dietary fibre that helps our digestion.

sci6_c005.text: Which of these is needed in small amounts but very important?
sci6_c005.explanation: Vitamins are micronutrients — needed in tiny amounts but essential.

sci6_c005.text: Which nutrient is the body's main source of quick energy?
sci6_c005.explanation: Carbohydrates are broken down quickly to give energy.

sci6_c005.text: Water in our body helps with?
sci6_c005.explanation: Water helps with digestion, temperature control, and removing waste.
